title: SCHC retry vector provenance mislabels timeout ACK-REQ as fifth All-1
description: Final ACK correctness review: test/vectors/schc_fragmentation.json sender_retry_exhaustion provenance says timeout replaces a fifth All-1 attempt, but trigger_event is timeout and pre_exhaustion_message 7800 is an ACK REQ. All-1 is emitted only for initial or missing-final-tile batches. Correct provenance to fifth request / timeout ACK REQ, align draft step wording, and keep Python/Rust executable assertions on the exact sequence.
